meta.title: 空降管理者第一次团队会怎么开
meta.title_en: How to Run Your First Team Meeting as a New Manager

scenes.title_cn: 员工关心的只有三件事
scenes.title_en: Employees care about three things only
scenes.context: 讲者指出员工只关心自己的工作、利益、价值，并说明第一次会应由组织先确认合法性。
sentences: 你当过员工就知道，没有人喜欢老板在上面一直讲话、东扯西拉。
Having been an employee yourself, you know nobody likes a boss who drones on and rambles.
东扯西拉：ramble / talk about random stuff
他们最关心的就那几个事：我自己的工作、我自己的利益和我自己的价值。
What they care about is simple: my work, my benefits, and my value.
最关心的：what they care about
因为你是被组织任命的，这等于像古代军权天授，我的合法性必须要被尊重。
You were appointed by the organization — it's like an ancient seal of office; your legitimacy must be respected.
军权天授：ancient seal of office
paraphrase: 员工只关心自己→别讲自己
Employees only care about themselves — so don't talk about yourself.
任命合法性→先被组织确认
Your legitimacy must first be confirmed by the organization.
scenes.speak: Having been an employee yourself, you know nobody likes a boss who drones on and rambles. What they care about is simple: my work, my benefits, and my value. You were appointed by the organization — it's like an ancient seal of office; your legitimacy must be respected.

scenes.title_cn: 别讲废话：三句话立规矩
scenes.title_en: Skip the small talk: three sentences to set the frame
scenes.context: 讲者指出别说心路历程和「三点又三点」，第一席话要回应员工的三个问题。
sentences: 不要絮絮叨叨地讲你自己的心路历程，我喜欢踢足球、我喜欢踢篮球。
Don't ramble about your personal journey — "I love soccer, I love basketball."
心路历程：personal journey
有一些管理者废话特别多，说那我跟大家讲三点，讲完三点又讲三点。
Some managers love the sound of their own voice: "Let me share three points," then three more.
讲三点又讲三点：three points, then three more
你要回应三个问题：你是谁、你来了以后会做什么、你跟大家工作关系的标准和尺度是什么。
Answer three questions: who you are, what you'll do here, and the standard and boundaries of your working relationship.
标准和尺度：standards and boundaries
paraphrase: Small talk about yourself? Nobody listens.
三句话→对应员工的三个问题
Three sentences map to the three things employees ask.
scenes.speak: Don't ramble about your personal journey — "I love soccer, I love basketball." Some managers love the sound of their own voice: "Let me share three points," then three more. Answer three questions: who you are, what you'll do here, and the standard and boundaries of your working relationship.

scenes.title_en: The three-sentence script and the close
scenes.context: 讲者给出三句话的具体话术，以及「我来这干事的」收尾和后续流程。
sentences: 我是被任命的，跟公司最大的上层、他们的关系很近的，所以权力我是有的。
I was appointed by leadership, close to the top, so the authority is already mine.
跟上层关系近：close to the top
大家先按照自己原来的工作方向上先走下去，我回头会单独再约大家慢慢地聊。
For now, keep moving on your current paths — I'll reach out to each of you one-on-one to get to know you.
单独约大家：reach out one-on-one
我来这里就是为了解决很多工作上的问题……最后那句话总结就是：我来这干事的，你们不要搞其他的。
I'm here to solve problems together… and to sum it up: I'm here to get work done — nothing else.
我来这干事的：I'm here to get work done
paraphrase: Three sentences: identity, plans, and boundaries.
收尾一句→立住干事的基调
The closing line sets the work-focused tone.
scenes.speak: I was appointed by leadership, close to the top, so the authority is already mine. For now, keep moving on your current paths — I'll reach out to each of you one-on-one to get to know you. I'm here to solve problems together… and to sum it up: I'm here to get work done — nothing else.

practice: I was appointed by the top leadership, so the authority is already mine.
Keep moving on your current paths — I'll follow up one-on-one.
If there's a problem, come to me directly; let's solve it together.
To sum it up: I'm here to get work done.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Let me talk about three points, then three points.
✓ 地道说法："Let me share three points," then three more.
three more 表达「又三点」更简洁。
✕ 直译腔：I was appointed by the organization, so my legality must be respected.
✓ 地道说法：My legitimacy comes from the appointment and must be respected.
legitimacy 比 legality 更准确。
✕ 直译腔：I will talk with everyone one by one later.
✓ 地道说法：I'll reach out to each of you one-on-one.
✕ 直译腔：I came here to do work, don't do other things.
✓ 地道说法：I'm here to get work done — nothing else.
get work done 是地道表达。
shifts: 空降第一次会=介绍自己
第一次会=合法性确认＋三句立规矩
员工只关心自己，废话越多越反感
一次会只是流程一环，后面还有试炼与汇报
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「东侧去了」校正为「东扯西拉」，「全员肯答案」校正为「全员恳谈会」，「标述」校正为「陈述」，「A种」校正为「A总（管理者）」，「全力让渡」校正为「权力让渡」，「留灵魂怎么着」校正为「留（由）您怎么着（定）」，「续续道道」校正为「絮絮叨叨」，「川普我正常背后的那些人」校正为「（老板）背后支持的那些人」，「试炼」保留原意，「盘解」校正为「盘解（掌控）」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
